title: Report: Justin Dedich will return soon, Fourth of July injury was not fireworks-related

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Justin Dedich will return soon, Fourth of July injury was not fireworks-related
sources.description: When Rams head coach Sean McVay said today that guard Justin Dedich was out of training camp because he “had a hand accident around the Fourth of July," it was reasonable to infer that McVay was describing a fireworks accident.
